regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, graphical abstract, and metadata
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title and aggregate visible-light hydrophosphinylation claim. The graphical abstract is a generic summary rather than an experiment-specific run; the publisher SI link does not establish workspace SI association.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1a field-level radical pathways
regions.finding: Classified the radical 1,4-difunctionalization/hydrofunctionalization drawing as a generic mechanistic map; propargyl/allenyl radicals and allenyl carbanion are not isolated current experiments.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1b cited nickel precedents
regions.finding: Classified Zhu's and Zhang's nickel-catalyzed phosphinoyl-diene syntheses as prior literature, not experiments of the present article.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1c and graphical-abstract current class
regions.finding: Classified the Ir/K3PO4/MeCN/blue-light hydrophosphinylation as the current generic reaction class; concrete rows occur in Table 1 and Schemes 2–5.

unresolved: Generic R/Ar/X/Y groups do not define unique structures or experiment-specific quantities.

regions.region: page 2 left-column context and optimization narrative
regions.finding: Mapped catalyst/base/solvent/light effects to the 15 independent Table 1 rows without creating narrative duplicates. Scheme 1b remains cited prior work and Scheme 1c remains the current generic class.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 1 header, entries 1–15, and footnotes a–e
regions.finding: Recorded all 15 optimization/control rows with shared charges, photocatalyst/base/solvent identity, footnote-c 1a charge, footnote-d 1 mol% catalyst, footnote-e dark condition, 24 h/r.t./Ar/40 W blue light, and isolated numeric/trace outcomes.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Scheme 2 scope narrative
regions.finding: Mapped the prose to the 27 Scheme 2 products shown on page 3, including heterocycles, functional groups, cyclic/internal and complex-substrate rows. CCDC 2311675 is characterization of 3aa, not another preparation or SI association.

unresolved: Table 1 omits workup, purification, isolated masses, and detection limits.
Compact Scheme 2 structures remain source-labeled and machine-unverified.

regions.region: page 3 left Scheme 2 product grid and caption/footnotes
regions.finding: Recorded 27 independent 1,3-enyne scope entries 3aa–3aaa with row-specific reaction times, isolated yields, three dr values, and footnote replacement of K3PO4 by Cs2CO3 (0.2 equiv) or DABCO (2.0 equiv). Shared catalyst, charges, MeCN volume, 40 W blue LEDs, Ar, room temperature, and 0.1 M were applied row-wise.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right Scheme 3 product grid, failure box, and caption
regions.finding: Recorded 14 successful phosphine-oxide scope entries 3ab–3ao with row times/yields and 3ao dr, plus three separate unsuccessful 2p/2q/2r rows. Footnote-b DABCO replacement was applied only to 3am and 3an.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Scheme 4 scale-up and three transformations
regions.finding: Recorded the independent 6.0 mmol/1.41 g/68% 3aa scale-up, Pd/C-H2 hydrogenation to 4, NIS conversion to 5 with Z,Z/E,Z 3.3:1, and ordered Ti(OiPr)4/(EtO)3SiH reduction then S8 oxidation to 6. The 87% value remains an overall two-stage product yield.

regions.region: page 3 lower narrative introducing mechanistic controls
regions.finding: The TEMPO/BHT sentence continues into Scheme 5 on page 4; the two trap experiments are represented once with cross-page evidence rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Scheme 2/3 omit workup, purification, isolated masses, and ordinary analytical details.
The 6.0 mmol scale denominator in Scheme 4 is not explicitly named.
Several Scheme 4 stage times/quantities/bases are not printed.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Scheme 5a radical-trapping arrows
regions.finding: Recorded separate TEMPO and BHT controls (3.0 equiv) with 3aa at 0% and 27%, respectively, and HRMS-detected phosphinoyl-radical adduct candidates. Detection is not treated as isolation or structure verification.

regions.region: page 4 middle-left Scheme 5b alkyl-bromide-tethered control
regions.finding: Recorded the distinct 1ab/2a control under standard conditions to alkynylcyclopropane 3aba in 33% after 48 h; the inset allenyl carbanion is proposed rather than isolated.

regions.region: page 4 left-column deuterium and light on/off prose
regions.finding: Recorded three main-text isotope controls: 2a-d (80% D) gives 29% D product; d3-MeCN gives 61% product/23% D; 5 equiv D2O gives 79% product/70% D. The Figure S9 light on/off conclusion is retained as an unresolved main-text control without importing unassociated SI plots.

regions.region: page 4 upper-right Scheme 6 and mechanism prose
regions.finding: Classified the IrIII/IrIV cycle and intermediates I–IV as a proposed radical-polar crossover mechanism, not isolated preparations.
